words.definition: A young dog.
words.example: The puppy chewed my shoe.

words.definition: A young cat.
words.example: The kitten is asleep.

words.definition: A small house for a dog, or a place where dogs stay.
words.example: We left the dog at a kennel.

words.definition: A glass tank for fish.
words.example: He cleaned the aquarium.

words.definition: A doctor for animals.
words.example: We took the cat to the vet.

words.definition: The foot of an animal with claws.
words.example: The dog gave me his paw.

words.definition: The long part at the back of an animal.
words.example: The dog wagged its tail.

words.definition: The soft hair on an animal.
words.example: The cat has soft fur.

words.definition: One of the long stiff hairs on a cat's face.
words.example: The cat twitched its whiskers.

words.definition: A sharp curved nail on an animal's foot.
words.example: The cat sharpened its claws.

words.definition: A word that introduces a condition.
words.example: If you're hungry, there's pizza in the fridge.

words.definition: A word used to compare two things.
words.example: My brother is taller than me.

words.definition: A word that means "even if".
words.example: Though it was raining, we went for a walk.

words.definition: A word used to talk about two possibilities.
words.example: I don't know whether he'll come.

words.definition: A word used to compare two different facts.
words.example: I love the beach, whereas my husband prefers the mountains.

words.definition: As soon as; after something happens.
words.example: Call me once you arrive.

words.definition: Up to the time that. Same as "until".
words.example: Wait here till I come back.

words.definition: And also. Used to add something.
words.example: It's cheap, plus it's close to work.

words.definition: For each.
words.example: The tickets cost ten dollars per person.

words.definition: By way of.
words.example: We flew to Rome via Paris.

words.definition: Money you get back when you return something.
words.example: I'd like a refund, please.

words.definition: To take something back to the shop where you bought it.
words.example: Can I return this if it doesn't fit?

words.definition: To give something back and get something else instead.
words.example: I'd like to exchange this for a bigger size.

words.definition: A promise from a company to repair a product if it breaks.
words.example: The phone comes with a one-year warranty.

words.definition: The name of a company's product.
words.example: What brand of shoes do you wear?

words.definition: A person who buys things from a shop or business.
words.example: Our customers love the new menu.

words.definition: The act of bringing goods to someone's home or office.
words.example: Delivery takes two to three days.

words.definition: How good or bad something is.
words.example: The quality of this jacket is excellent.

words.definition: Something that is made or grown to be sold.
words.example: This product is sold out.

words.definition: The goods a shop has available to sell.
words.example: Sorry, we're out of stock.

words.definition: Number six in a series.
words.example: It's her sixth birthday.

words.definition: Number seven in a series.
words.example: He finished seventh in the race.

words.definition: Number eight in a series.
words.example: The meeting is on the eighth of June.

words.definition: Number nine in a series.
words.example: It's the ninth episode.

words.definition: Number ten in a series.
words.example: Today is our tenth anniversary.

words.definition: Happening or existing before.
words.example: I loved her previous book.

words.definition: First or at the beginning.
words.example: My initial reaction was shock.

words.definition: Final, or the best.
words.example: The ultimate goal is to be fluent.

words.definition: Most important or first.
words.example: Safety is our primary concern.

words.definition: Less important, or coming after the first.
words.example: Price is a secondary concern.

words.definition: A low area of land between hills or mountains.
words.example: The village sits in a green valley.

words.definition: A large dry area with very little rain.
words.example: It gets freezing at night in the desert.

words.definition: A steep rock face, often next to the sea.
words.example: They stood at the edge of the cliff.

words.definition: A place where a river falls from a high place.
words.example: The waterfall was taller than I expected.

words.definition: An open area of land used for crops or sports.
words.example: Cows were grazing in the field.

words.definition: The top layer of the ground where plants grow.
words.example: This soil is perfect for growing tomatoes.

words.definition: A flat green part of a plant.
words.example: A yellow leaf fell on my head.

words.definition: A part of a tree that grows out from the trunk.
words.example: The bird sat on a low branch.

words.definition: A small hard part of a plant that grows into a new plant.
words.example: Plant the seeds in spring.

words.definition: The time when crops are gathered, or the crops themselves.
words.example: It was a good harvest this year.

words.definition: Without doubt.
words.example: I'll certainly be there.

words.definition: In every place.
words.example: I looked everywhere for my keys.

words.definition: For all time.
words.example: I'll remember this forever.

words.definition: To a high degree.
words.example: The movie is highly recommended.

words.definition: In no place.
words.example: There's nowhere to park.

words.definition: In some way that you do not know.
words.example: Somehow, we managed to finish.

words.definition: Used to show you think something is true.
words.example: Surely you remember her name?

words.definition: Completely.
words.example: I totally agree.

words.definition: Really.
words.example: I'm truly sorry.

words.definition: In or to another country across the sea.
words.example: She lives overseas.

words.definition: A soft, round fruit with a stone inside.
words.example: This plum is very sweet.

words.definition: A small round blue fruit.
words.example: I put blueberries in my pancakes.

words.definition: A soft red berry.
words.example: She made raspberry jam.

words.definition: A large green fruit with red flesh.
words.example: We ate watermelon at the picnic.

words.definition: A sweet tropical fruit with orange flesh.
words.example: I love fresh mango.

words.definition: A small green fruit with brown skin.
words.example: Add a kiwi to the salad.

words.definition: A green fruit with soft creamy flesh.
words.example: I'll have avocado on toast.

words.definition: A soft sweet fruit with many small seeds.
words.example: The figs were ripe.

words.definition: A small green citrus fruit.
words.example: Squeeze lime on your tacos.

words.definition: A large citrus fruit with a sour taste.
words.example: She has grapefruit for breakfast.

words.definition: To tell people each other's names when they meet.
words.example: Let me introduce you to my sister.

words.definition: To say hello to someone.
words.example: She greeted everyone with a smile.

words.definition: A kind thing you say about someone.
words.example: Thanks for the compliment!

words.definition: To say you are sorry.
words.example: I want to apologize for what I said.

words.definition: To tell someone you are happy about their success.
words.example: Congratulate Sara. She just got engaged!

words.definition: To disagree with someone in an angry way.
words.example: They argue about money all the time.

words.definition: To stop being angry with someone.
words.example: I hope you can forgive me.

words.definition: To believe that someone is honest and reliable.
words.example: I trust her. She's never lied to me.

words.definition: Talk about other people's private lives.
words.example: I don't like office gossip.

words.definition: To talk in a friendly, informal way.
words.example: We chatted for hours.

words.definition: To ask formally for a job, a place or permission.
words.example: I'm going to apply for that job.

words.definition: A meeting where someone asks you questions to see if you suit a job.
words.example: I have a job interview tomorrow morning.

words.definition: A short document that lists your education and work history.
words.example: Send me your resume by email.

words.definition: Knowledge or skill you get from doing something.
words.example: Do you have any experience in sales?

words.definition: An ability to do something well.
words.example: Good communication is an important skill.

words.definition: To give someone a job.
words.example: They're planning to hire two new people.

words.definition: A person who is being considered for a job or position.
words.example: She was the strongest candidate for the job.

words.definition: A move to a more important job.
words.example: He got a promotion after two years.

words.definition: To officially leave your job.
words.example: She resigned after a disagreement with her boss.

words.definition: The series of jobs a person has during their working life.
words.example: She started her career as a teacher.

words.definition: More than enough.
words.example: Don't worry, there's plenty of time.

words.definition: More than two but not many.
words.example: I've called him several times.

words.definition: Whole or complete.
words.example: I spent the entire day cleaning.

words.definition: All of something.
words.example: She ate the whole cake!

words.definition: The final amount when everything is added together.
words.example: What's the total for these items?

words.definition: Several different.
words.example: We discussed various options.

words.definition: Twice as much or twice as many.
words.example: I'd like a double espresso.

words.definition: More than what is usual or needed.
words.example: Do you have an extra pen?

words.definition: Normal or typical, not unusual.
words.example: The average price here is ten dollars.

words.definition: The largest amount allowed or possible.
words.example: The maximum speed here is sixty.
